Settings.PreserveCanvasSettings.en: Keep canvas settings when creating a canvas

Settings.PreserveCanvasSettingsHint.zh: 默认关闭：新建画布恢复第一个官方预设的背景、网格与透视参数。开启后沿用当前参数；清空已有标注始终保留画布参数。
Settings.PreserveCanvasSettingsHint.en: Off by default: a new canvas restores the first official preset's background, grid and perspective settings. Turn on to keep the current values. Clearing annotations always keeps canvas settings.
